description: Fill the AcroForm fields of a supplied PDF and optionally flatten it. Provide the source PDF as exactly one of { base64 } or { url } (an https URL fetched behind an SSRF guard; base64 avoids any fetch), plus a fields map of AcroForm field name → value. Field names must match the PDF internal names exactly (case-sensitive); obtain them from whoever supplied the form, since docgen does not expose them. Names with no AcroForm counterpart come back in unmatchedFields[] rather than failing — correct them and re-render. Set flatten to bake the values in so the result is no longer editable. Returns a delivery envelope with a documentId, resource URI, pageCount, and inline base64 when small enough.

fields.description: AcroForm field name → value. Names must match the PDF internal field names exactly (case-sensitive). Unmatched names are returned in unmatchedFields[].

flatten.description: When true, flatten the form after filling so values are baked in and no longer editable.

sourcePdf.description: The fillable PDF source — provide exactly ONE of { base64 } or { url }.

base64.description: The source PDF as a base64 string; line breaks/whitespace and an optional `data:application/pdf;base64,` prefix are tolerated. Avoids any network fetch.

url.description: An https URL serving the source PDF. Fetched behind an SSRF guard; must be public and serve application/pdf.

name: docgen_fill_form

document.description: Delivery envelope for a rendered document — metadata plus resource/inline byte access.

byteSize.description: Size of the rendered artifact in bytes.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the document was rendered.

documentId.description: Opaque id minted by the render/export/fill tool — the chaining key for docgen_get_document and the docgen://document/{id} resource. Format `doc_` + 24 url-safe chars. Obtainable ONLY from a render/export/fill tool output; not guessable or constructible.

downloadUrl.description: Reserved for a future HTTP download route; not emitted in v1 (the field is always absent). Fetch the bytes via resourceUri or inlineBase64 instead.

inlineBase64.description: The document bytes, base64-encoded. Present when the artifact is at or under the inline threshold; omitted (field absent) when larger — fetch via the resource URI instead.

mimeType.description: Mime type of the rendered artifact — PDF or xlsx.

pageCount.description: Number of pages — present for PDF documents (render_pdf, fill_form) only.

resourceUri.description: Stable read URI `docgen://document/{documentId}` resolving to the document.

sheetCount.description: Number of worksheets — present for xlsx documents (export_spreadsheet) only.

ttlSecondsRemaining.description: Seconds until the stored artifact expires and becomes unreadable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_a_form`: The source PDF has no AcroForm fields to fill (a flat or XFA-only PDF). `invalid_pdf_source`: sourcePdf.base64 was provided but is not a valid base64-encoded PDF. `source_unfetchable`: sourcePdf.url did not return a fetchable PDF — non-2xx, wrong content-type, too large, or blocked by the SSRF guard. `invalid_source`: Neither base64 nor url was provided for sourcePdf, or both were. `document_too_large`: The filled PDF exceeded the configured maximum document size. `render_timeout`: Filling exceeded the configured time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

unmatchedFields.description: Field names from the input map that had no matching AcroForm field. Empty when every field matched. Correct these and re-render to fill them.
